stories.title: La OTAN celebra el acuerdo sobre Groenlandia por su importancia para la seguridad del Ártico

en.title: NATO celebrates Greenland agreement for Arctic security importance
en.summary: NATO welcomed an agreement involving Greenland, citing its strategic significance for Arctic security. Denmark and Greenland stated the accord does not transfer sovereignty despite Trump's claimed demands for permanent control.

stories.title: Google admite por primera vez que su IA ha ‘hackeado’ a tres empresas

en.title: Google admits for the first time that its AI has 'hacked' three companies
en.summary: Google acknowledged that its Gemini AI successfully breached three companies during a May cybersecurity evaluation conducted by an independent testing firm.

stories.title: Dictan prisión preventiva en México para el presunto asesino de la española Claudia Tacoronte

en.title: Mexico issues preventive detention for suspected killer of Spanish woman Claudia Tacoronte
en.summary: A Mexican court ordered preventive detention for a suspect in the death of Spanish national Claudia Tacoronte. The victim's father traveled to the crime scene in Morelos for body repatriation following the suspect's arrest.

stories.title: Jorge Martín se impone en la 'sprint race' del Gran Premio de Austria y recupera el liderato

en.title: Jorge Martín wins Austria Grand Prix sprint race and regains championship lead
en.summary: Spanish rider Jorge Martín claimed victory in the sprint race at Austria's Spielberg circuit following a strong recovery from seventh place. Marc Márquez finished second while Bezzechi completed the podium.

stories.title: La Fiscalía remite al juez denuncias de menores en Ceuta por vejaciones y abusos

en.title: Prosecutor refers complaints from minors in Ceuta to judge for abuse and mistreatment
en.summary: Several migrant teenagers have reported experiencing mistreatment, threats, and assaults in Ceuta. The Public Ministry states it has not opened a general investigation into the protection system.

stories.title: La Fiscalía ceutí envía al juez denuncias de menores por vejaciones en centros de acogida

en.title: Ceuta prosecutor sends judge complaints from minors about mistreatment in reception centers
en.summary: Minors in reception centers report experiencing verbal abuse, physical violence, and punishment for requesting access to phones or bedding. The cases have been forwarded to judicial authorities.

stories.title: La OTAN acoge con “satisfacción” el acuerdo de EE UU y Dinamarca sobre Groenlandia

en.title: NATO welcomes "satisfaction" on US and Denmark agreement regarding Greenland
en.summary: NATO has expressed satisfaction with an agreement reached among the United States, Denmark, and Greenland, stating it will promote security, stability, and cooperation.

stories.title: Estados Unidos alcanza un acuerdo de seguridad con Groenlandia

en.title: United States reaches security agreement with Greenland
en.summary: The United States and Greenland have signed a security agreement that increases American military presence on the Arctic island, though falling short of broader control objectives previously indicated.

stories.title: Trump logra el control militar de Groenlandia sin comprar la isla

en.title: Trump gains military control of Greenland without buying the island
en.summary: Trump announced an agreement with Denmark and Greenland giving the United States permanent control over the Arctic island's security and authorization over any foreign military presence there, along with plans for significant U.S. troop deployment.

stories.title: Trump anuncia un acuerdo con Dinamarca para asumir el “control permanente de la seguridad” de Groenlandia

en.title: Trump announces agreement with Denmark to assume "permanent control of security" in Greenland
en.summary: Trump announced a security agreement regarding Greenland that Denmark's Prime Minister Frederiksen confirmed, describing it as shared Arctic security. The accord involves preventing hostile nations from establishing bases.

stories.title: La Fiscalía investiga abusos y vejaciones en los centros de menores de Ceuta

en.title: Public Prosecutor Investigates Abuse and Mistreatment in Ceuta Minors' Centers
en.summary: Several migrant girls have fled centers in Ceuta reporting physical abuse by staff members, prompting a formal investigation by the Public Prosecutor's office.

stories.title: Trump anuncia un pacto de “control permanente” sobre seguridad en Groenlandia y Dinamarca matiza que será “seguridad compartida”

en.title: Trump Announces "Permanent Control" Pact on Greenland and Denmark Security; Denmark Clarifies It Will Be "Shared Security"
en.summary: Trump announced a security agreement regarding Greenland, while Denmark's Prime Minister clarified that the accord respects the kingdom's sovereignty and Greenland's right to self-determination.

stories.title: Los 'hackers' usan IA de Anthropic para entrar en OpenAI

en.title: Hackers use Anthropic's AI to access OpenAI
en.summary: A security firm discovered that attackers exploited artificial intelligence tools from Anthropic to gain unauthorized access to internal systems of ChatGPT's parent company.

stories.title: La IA no vuelve al cole este curso en la Gran Manzana

en.title: AI does not return to school this academic year in the Big Apple
en.summary: New York City's mayor has banned artificial intelligence use in primary school classrooms for the 2026-2027 school year, while secondary students will receive instruction on AI risks and biases.

stories.title: Rosewood Luang Prabang, refugio de aventureros

en.title: Rosewood Luang Prabang, refuge for adventurers
en.summary: The Rosewood Luang Prabang hotel offers guests an experience beyond typical accommodation, presenting itself as a state of mind and a way of engaging with the world's history.

stories.title: El retraso en la ley 'cripto' de EEUU frena el despegue del sector

en.title: Delay in US crypto law hampers sector growth
en.summary: The U.S. Senate rejected approval of the Clarity Act, comprehensive cryptocurrency legislation awaited by investors, with potential conflicts of interest involving Trump and his family's crypto-related businesses cited as a major obstacle.

stories.title: Gadgets para grabar conversaciones y llamadas con IA

en.title: Gadgets for recording conversations and calls with AI
en.summary: Devices capable of recording and transcribing conversations and calls using artificial intelligence technology are now available.
